messages:
alex_sales: Heads up — HealthSystems APAC POC trying to pin redwood-llama-70b-v2@2025-11-01 to ap-southeast-1. Getting model_not_found and occasional rate_limit. Need a workaround today.

sana_se: Can you share the exact error JSON? region param used?

alex_sales: Error: {"error":"model_not_found", "message":"Model not available in ap-southeast-1"} They sent region: ap-southeast-1 in body.

jordi_infra: Short answer: 70b-v2 not replicated to that region (licensing + capacity). Options: 1) allow region-fallback to ap-east-1, 2) use in-region smaller quant model (redwood-llama-13b-quant), 3) Dedicated trial to provision local replica.

lee_security: Note: if we route cross-region, update security questionnaire — data crosses into ap-east-1. TLS in transit ok but they asked about retention.

sana_se: For immediate unblock recommend switch to model redwood-llama-13b-quant@v1 or add header x-redwood-region-fallback: ap-east-1. Document perf/quality tradeoffs.

karen_cs: I'll present three options to the customer and ask which residency constraints are hard requirement.

deploy-bot: autoscaler: queued provisioning request for ap-southeast-1 replica (pending approvals) at 1799991250

jordi_infra: If they need price for 2-week Dedicated trial (~8 A100-eq), ballpark $8k/week + SRE support. Finance to confirm.

alex_sales: Perfect. Sending options and the quick config snippet now. Thanks all.
